title: urobotrya congolana subsp. afzelii
intro: Urobotrya congolana subsp. afzelii, commonly known as Urobotrya afzelii, is a plant species in the family Gonolobaceae. It is a medicinal plant native to tropical Africa, particularly in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The plant is used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Urobotrya congolana subsp. afzelii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiparasitic, and antiviral activities.
